texts.missionStart.generic.0: Overlord to Viper 1 — picture is hostile. Weapons free.
texts.missionStart.generic.1: Viper 1, Overlord. Bandits on the scope. Cleared to engage.
texts.missionStart.parispatrol.0: Viper 1, Overlord. Three bandits over the Seine. The City of Light is your range today — weapons free.
texts.missionStart.parispatrol.1: Picture: three hostiles between the Tower and Montmartre. Clean them up, Viper 1.
texts.missionStart.generic.2: All stations, Viper 1 is on station. Commencing sweep.
texts.missionStart.parispatrol.2: Overlord here. Paris is closed airspace until those three are swimming in the Seine.
texts.missionStart.baycap.1: Overlord: hostiles over San Francisco. Fog rolls in at dusk — be done before it does.
texts.missionStart.baycap.0: Viper 1, five bandits over the Bay. From the Financial District to the Golden Gate — sweep it clean.
texts.missionStart.yosemite.0: Viper 1, bandits in the valley — between El Capitan and Half Dome. Mind the granite; it does not forgive.
texts.missionStart.yosemite.1: Overlord: five hostiles low in Yosemite. Terrain masking works both ways down there.
texts.missionStart.baycap.2: Five contacts, Viper 1. The Bay Area is counting on you. Weapons free.
texts.missionStart.yosemite.2: The valley is hot, Viper 1. Watch your altitude — those walls are a kilometer tall.
texts.missionStart.chicagosiege.0: Viper 1, Overlord. Five bandits hold the Loop. Splash them between the towers and get out over the lake.
texts.missionStart.chicagosiege.1: Chicago is under siege — Willis to Navy Pier. Thread the towers, Viper 1.
texts.missionStart.chicagosiege.2: Overlord: five contacts over the lakefront. The Windy City wants its sky back.
texts.missionStart.nycfury.0: Viper 1, this is the big one. Six bandits own Manhattan — WTC to the Park. Take it back.
texts.missionStart.nycfury.2: Six contacts, Viper 1. Manhattan Fury is a go. Good hunting.
texts.missionStart.nycfury.1: Overlord: six hostiles over New York. Extraction at Lady Liberty when the sky is clean.
texts.missionStart.southampton.1: Overlord: five contacts on the South Fork. Try not to part anyone’s hair on Meadow Lane.
texts.missionStart.southampton.0: Viper 1, bandits over the Hamptons — Shinnecock to Coopers Beach. Keep it low and fast over the dunes.
texts.missionStart.southampton.2: Beach sweep, Viper 1. Five bandits between the inlet and the estates. Weapons free.

texts.allClear.0: Splash the last one — picture is clean! Extraction is open, Viper 1.
texts.allClear.2: Scope’s clear, Viper 1. Egress and extract.

texts.shieldsCritical.2: You’re on your last shield — evade, evade!
texts.shieldsCritical.0: Last shield, Viper 1! One more and you’re going down!
texts.shieldsCritical.1: Shields critical! Do not take another hit!
texts.victory.0: Viper 1 is through the portal. Mission complete — drinks are on Overlord.
texts.victory.2: That’s a wrap. Skies cleared, pilot recovered. Well done.
texts.down.0: Viper 1 is down! I say again, Viper 1 is down!
texts.down.1: We lost Viper 1. Mark the crash site.
texts.spoofed.0: Flares! Your missile went for the flares, Viper 1. Get in closer — or go guns.
texts.spoofed.1: He spoofed it — seeker chased a flare. Press in, or take him with the cannon.
texts.spoofed.2: Negative hit, that was a flare. Close the range before you fire.
texts.gunsKill.0: Guns kill! Guns kill! That one’s all pilot, Viper 1.
texts.gunsKill.1: Splash one with the cannon — nobody spoofs a bullet.
texts.gunsKill.2: Guns, guns, guns — and he’s down. Outstanding.
texts.recharge.1: Systems recovered — you’ve got a shield back.
texts.recharge.2: Shield restored. Stay clean out there.
texts.winchester.0: Viper 1, you’re Winchester — no missiles left. Go guns, or hit the portal to rearm.
texts.winchester.1: Rails are empty. Cannon only, or run for the portal.
texts.rearm.0: Rearm complete — six missiles on the rails. Get back in there.
texts.winchester.2: That was your last missile. Guns, guns, guns — or rearm at extraction.
texts.rearm.2: Six fresh missiles. Go make them count.
texts.checkSix.0: Check six, Viper 1! Bandit on your tail!
texts.checkSix.1: Break! He’s behind you — six o’clock, closing!
texts.checkSix.2: Viper 1, you’ve got one on your six. Turn hard!
texts.wingFox.1: Viper 2, fox two on the bandit.
texts.wingKill.0: Splash one! That one’s mine, Lead.
texts.wingKill.1: Viper 2, good kill. Scratch one bandit.
texts.wingKill.2: He’s down — Two’s got a kill.
texts.check.0: Overlord reading you loud and clear, Viper 1.
